text:
carmen-fin: Heads-up: found a small set of customers who were enrolled in the A/B pricing experiment but their grandfathering flag got dropped during yesterday's vendor price-sheet import. 2 invoices already issued. getting inbound support tickets.

matt-ops: Ugh. Which invoices/customers?

carmen-fin: INV-2025-05-02-1122, INV-2025-05-02-1133; custs: BETA-9, BETA-14. Looks like they were in bucket A (preserve) but got billed at bucket B pricing.

sophia-revops: I'm checking experiment-assignments and vendor-sheet mapping. Vendor delivered a column named `legacy_preserve` instead of our expected `preserve_legacy`. ingest mapping should have tolerated aliases but maybe it didn't.

lee-eng: We rolled a new CSV parser for vendor sheets a few hours before the import. The alias mapping is in a separate compatibility table that should have covered `legacy_preserve` -> `preserve_legacy`. I'll inspect the compatibility loader.

matt-ops: Can we do a quick query to confirm scope? I'll run: `SELECT invoice_id, amount, preserve_legacy FROM invoices WHERE invoice_id IN ('INV-2025-05-02-1122','INV-2025-05-02-1133')`

billing-bot: Query result: INV-2025-05-02-1122 -> preserve_legacy=false; INV-2025-05-02-1133 -> preserve_legacy=false.

sophia-revops: Confirmed. The experiment service still returns bucket=A for those customers. So the error is in price ingestion, not experiment assignment.

matt-ops: Proposal: run a scoped reingest for those customer rows from the raw vendor file and then trigger invoice correction if pricing changes. I'll do a dry-run first. ETA 45m.

lee-eng: I found the issue: compatibility loader accidentally skipped alias mappings when `vendor_id` is present due to a short-circuit. Fix is trivial. Opening PR now with test vector that includes `legacy_preserve` alias and an integration test for the import path.

sophia-revops: Good. Also want to confirm whether our A/B rollout gating logic has a rollback window. If more than 50 invoices affected we trigger manual review. Current impact is 2, so automated path ok but we still have to send customer comms.

matt-ops: Dry-run output (snippet):
```
2025-05-03T16:02:01Z INFO -> reingesting 2 rows from vendor file
2025-05-03T16:02:02Z INFO -> row BETA-9: preserve_legacy true after alias fix
2025-05-03T16:02:03Z INFO -> invoice INV-2025-05-02-1122 flagged for credit recalculation -> delta $9.80
2025-05-03T16:02:04Z INFO -> row BETA-14: preserve_legacy true after alias fix
2025-05-03T16:02:05Z INFO -> invoice INV-2025-05-02-1133 flagged for credit recalculation -> delta $0.00 (already had promo)
```

matt-ops: Looks straightforward. plan to run the live reingest + credit apply at 17:00 UTC.

sophia-revops: I'll draft a short message for customers and CSMs: one-line apology, explanation that a mapping mismatch caused temporary pricing, credit applied, no action required. will post here for review.

tara-legal: Please include wording about "no change to contractual terms" and avoid implying liability. If any customer asks for expedited cash refund instead of account credit, route to me.

carmen-fin: tag @matt-ops when you kick off the live run. also, can we add a check to the import pipeline to detect unknown header names and warn in the import report? that would catch vendor schema drift early.

lee-eng: adding an import-report warning for unmapped headers to the PR. also adding a CI test that fails the import if critical columns (price_usd, preserve_legacy, customer_id) are missing.

matt-ops: Live reingest started at 17:00 UTC. Command: `./scripts/reingest_vendor_rows --invoice INV-2025-05-02-1122,INV-2025-05-02-1133`

billing-bot: Action: credit applied INV-2025-05-02-1122 -> $9.80 (account credit). INV-2025-05-02-1133 -> no credit (promo already covered). Status: completed.

sophia-revops: message draft: "We're sorry — due to a vendor file schema mismatch, two invoices temporarily billed at the experiment rate instead of your preserved legacy rate. We've applied the appropriate account credit; no action required. If you'd prefer a refund, reply and we'll assist." Thoughts?

tara-legal: tweak accepted. change "reply" to "contact us via billing@redwood.ai" and remove "we're sorry" -> use "we apologize".

sophia-revops: updated message posted to CSM channel and queued for outbound.

carmen-fin: Great catch everyone. Lee: merge the parser fix and import-warning PR after CI. Matt: add a step to the rollout checklist to validate header aliases before each vendor import for the next two weeks. I'll file the postmortem template and assign owners. :white_check_mark:
